alignments.note: Waw rendered by the postpositive "also", which is settled where a waw is present (rule 51). Variant WLC.JOB.39.30.v003 resolved to r00-base, which covers this token.
"ones" is the supplied generic and "young" carries the lexeme (rule 31); covered by the same resolved variant.
Suffix rendered by the possessive (rule 18); covered by the same resolved variant.
Verb with its particle completing the lexeme (rule 44).
Preposition with the relative fused in the single "where", headed on the relative (rules 22, 30); the locative predicate takes the clause's supplied copula (rule 49), discontinuous under rule 25.
Anarthrous substantival adjective takes the English "the" the ASV supplies to make it a noun phrase (rule 46).
Adverbial predicate takes the construction-supplied copula (rule 20); head on the word carrying the lexeme.
Independent subject pronoun (rule 20: an explicit subject takes only its own English).

review_notes: The copula of "where the slain are" is given to the locative בַּאֲשֶׁר as the clause's predicate under rule 49; attaching it to the substantival "the slain" was the alternative.
